leader.name: Vlad Tenev
leader.caveat: Includes 565,079 shares he votes but has no economic interest in.

structure.note: Class A has one vote per share and Class B ten. All Class B is held by the co-founders Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Bhatt and their related entities, who are parties to a Founders' Voting Agreement. The FY2025 10-K says that as of December 31, 2025 the founders and their related entities hold approximately 12% of the outstanding common stock and over 50% of the voting power. The 2026 proxy gives Tenev 26.1% and Bhatt 32.0% of voting power. 'controlled' is true because the founders vote together under that agreement.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001783879-26-000023, filed February 18, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001783879-26-000053, filed April 22, 2026). OWNERSHIP: the proxy gives percentages per class (Tenev 44.9% of Class B) and of voting power (26.1%), not of all shares, so the economic share is given only as leader.derived (5.47%). It counts all shares beneficially owned. Excluding the 565,079 Bhatt Family LLC shares, over which Tenev has voting but no economic interest, his own shares are 48,676,479 (6,907 Class A + 48,669,572 Class B). LARGEST HOLDERS are listed on a class basis, as the proxy states them only per class: co-founder Baiju Bhatt 61,076,048 Class B = 55.7% of Class B (32.0% of voting power; his row also counts the 565,079 Bhatt Family LLC shares that Tenev votes, so the two founders' class percentages overlap by that amount), and BlackRock 55,763,578 Class A = 7.0% of Class A as of September 30, 2025. The proxy adds that it believes Vanguard subsidiaries collectively own about 94,436,459 Class A shares (11.9%) after Vanguard's internal realignment; that is not a reported 5% row, so it is not listed. BUYBACKS: $653 million of Class A repurchased in 2025. The $437 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards is excluded. GEOGRAPHY: null. Robinhood reports one operating segment and no revenue-by-geography table in the FY2025 10-K; at December 31, 2025 the proxy counts 2,606 of 2,958 employees in North America, 337 in Europe and 15 in Asia.

clientAssets.label: Total Platform Assets (previously reported as Assets Under Custody)

ecosystem.notes: Total Platform Assets is a stock, defined in the FY2025 10-K as "the sum of the fair value of all equities, options, cryptocurrency, futures (including options on futures and swaps, including event contracts), cash held by users in their accounts, net of receivables from users (previously reported as Assets Under Custody), and any such assets managed by RIAs using TradePMR's platform that are not custodied by Robinhood"; from June 2025 it includes cryptocurrency on Bitstamp, so it is broader than the FY2024 AUC figure ($192.9 billion). The 10-K defines Notional Trading Volume ("the aggregate dollar value (purchase price or sale price as applicable) of trades executed in that asset class on our platforms over a specified period of time") but this lens does not use it as a measure: it is not third parties' sales, and the FY2025 10-K again gives no annual dollar total, only growth in average Notional Trading Volume per trader. The 10-K also reports Net Deposits of $68.1 billion for 2025; that is net client money moved onto the platform, not volume transacted through it, so it is not used as a measure. No take rate should be computed on Total Platform Assets.
